verdict.rationale: Every Orama Cloud project ships an MCP server that lets users interact with their project data from ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI assistants. Orama also offers AI-powered NLP search and an AnswerSession that answers natural-language questions. All of this centres on querying data, though; nothing shows the product itself can be operated or administered through natural-language commands. Missing for 10: natural-language control of management operations (creating indexes or schemas, inserting or deleting data, configuration), details of which actions the MCP tools expose, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
